## The problem

What's the pain point in your current workflow? Describe the situation
where zinsight today *doesn't* answer a question you'd want it to.

> Example: "zinsight detects my Express routes but doesn't surface
> middleware applied to each route — I have to read the code to know
> which routes require auth."

## What would help

The smallest change you can imagine that would solve it.

> Example: "An optional 'Middleware' column next to each API endpoint
> in the generated table."

## Out of scope

If there's a related thing you specifically *don't* want, mention it.

> Example: "Don't try to detect *runtime* middleware order — static
> analysis can't reliably do that. Just per-route declared middleware."

## Anything else

Links to similar features in other tools, mockups, sample output, etc.
